0022600005.text: The Warriors and Lakers both open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, which follows a 2025-26 series that the Warriors lost 1-3, including a 119-103 defeat in Golden State on April 9, 2026. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, who are both out after knee surgery, while Kristaps Porzingis is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason and is a game-time decision. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Warriors a 35% chance of winning.
